verdict.rationale: Rev AI is a cloud speech-to-text service, so a data-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The pack contains no documented control or policy that prevents customer audio or transcripts from being used for model training. HIPAA-compliant processing and on-prem deployment are related privacy features, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
